This 180 cm pop-up Christmas tree combines 517 PVC branch tips with pine needles in two foliage textures. The branches have a flocked finish for a snow-covered appearance, and 170 warm white LEDs are fitted to the tree. Its pop-up construction uses a supporting frame and a top section, reducing the number of separate branches that need to be arranged individually. A crossed metal base supports the tree. The product information lists a 76 cm tree width and a 45 cm stand diameter.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and wood construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Crafted from wood with a vibrant red finish for defined festive appearance.

5056797097698.sourceDescription:
Welcome guests with a beautiful glow this Christmas with this pre-lit micro LED 2D wreath from MySmartBuy. Densely packed micro LEDs trace the classic wreath shape, creating a crisp, sparkling ring of light that looks stunning on a front door or wall. Choose from 50cm or 70cm sizes, with up to 1200 LEDs, in warm white for a cosy traditional glow or cool white for a frosty, contemporary look. A hanging point makes it easy to put up on doors, walls, windows and fences, and it comes with a storage box so it stays in perfect condition between seasons. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use. It is supplied with a 5m lead cable, giving plenty of reach from your socket, and the built-in timer lights it for 6 hours and then switches it off for 18 hours, so it comes on at the same time every evening without you needing to remember. A lit wreath is the perfect finishing touch for the front of the house, giving visitors a warm welcome and making your home look instantly festive from the street. Pair it with matching lights along the porch or a garland around the door frame for a coordinated look. A beautiful way to welcome guests this Christmas, it can be brought out year after year to make your home look instantly festive. At a glance: 2D micro LED wreath | 50cm or 70cm | up to 1200 LEDs | warm white or cool white | hanging point | storage box | 5m lead cable | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | indoor and outdoor use.

5056159914298.variantName: MySmartBuy Set of 3 Light Up Christmas Present Boxes, LED Gift Decorations
5056159914298.sourceDescription:
Add a glamorous festive accent to your home with this set of 3 light up Christmas gift boxes from MySmartBuy. Each present is made from cotton-effect covered wire, which creates a delicate, lacy texture, and is wrapped with a sparkling silver glitter ribbon and finished with a generous silver bow. The set is lit with 45 warm white LEDs, which glow softly through the open, lace-like texture to give a gentle, magical light. The three graduated sizes, 20cm, 15cm and 10cm cubes, can be stacked into a tower, grouped together under the Christmas tree, or spread across a mantelpiece, sideboard or hallway table for a chic festive display. The built-in auto timer switches the lights on for 6 hours and off for 18 hours, so they come on at the same time every evening without you needing to remember. Being battery operated, there are no trailing cables and you can place them wherever they look best. Each set requires 6 x AA batteries. A stylish, contemporary way to bring sparkle to your Christmas decorating, and a lovely gift for anyone who loves elegant silver and white decor. At a glance: set of 3 gift boxes | 20cm, 15cm and 10cm cubes | cotton-effect covered wire | silver glitter ribbons and bows | 45 warm white LEDs per set | 6 hours on / 18 hours off timer | battery operated, 6 x AA per set.
SET OF 3 GIFT BOXES – 20cm, 15cm and 10cm cubes for a chic festive display.
45 WARM WHITE LEDS – Each set lit with 45 LEDs for a soft glow.
AUTO TIMER – Six hours on and 18 hours off.
GLAMOROUS DESIGN – Cotton-effect covered wire with gold ribbons.
BATTERY OPERATED – Requires 6 x AA batteries per set.

Product Overview

 This pre-assembled snow flocked Christmas wreath is a ready-to-hang festive decoration.

Application Scenarios

 Perfect for front door, window, fireplace mantel, wall and porch decoration. 
 Great for Christmas party, winter holiday decor. Suitable for indoor and covered outdoor locations.

Notes

Expertly manufactured with high-quality plastic materials, this wreath retains its bright colour and full shape for repeated seasonal use. The sturdy structural design effectively prevents colour fading and foliage shedding, keeping the door wreath fresh and beautiful year after year.
Built-In Hanging Design for Effortless Installation
Fitted with a solid plastic backing panel and pre-drilled hanging holes, this wreath can be easily mounted on doors, windows, fireplaces and walls. The reliable fixing structure ensures stable and secure placement throughout the entire Christmas holiday period.
Multi-Purpose Festive Home Decoration
With a versatile 40cm classic size, this wreath is perfect for decorating front entryways, fireplace mantels, windows and walls. Suitable for both indoor and sheltered outdoor use, it effortlessly fills every corner of your home with rich Christmas festive cheer.
Fully Assembled Ready-To-Hang Design
This Christmas wreath comes fully pre-assembled with no complex setup required. Simply unwrap and hang it up to instantly upgrade your home’s festive look. Boasting a timeless classic style, it complements various decorative themes, including traditional and modern farmhouse Christmas decor.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The brown finish and fabric construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display

Double Sided Design

Water Resistant
The water resistant construction is useful where occasional moisture is part of the intended use. Allow damp surfaces to dry after use and follow the stated limits for exposure.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion

Give the detail room to show

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.
